id.instruksi: Di stasiun, barang dicari dengan membuka satu per satu dari kiri dan berhenti saat ketemu. Kalau tidak ada, semuanya dibuka. Hitung berapa yang dibuka.
id.q1: Isi kartu di dalam loker, dari kiri: 12, 5, 9, 3, 17, 6. Cari kartu 3 dengan membuka loker satu per satu dari kiri. Berapa loker yang dibuka sampai kartu 3 ketemu?
id.q2: Isi kartu di dalam loker, dari kiri: 8, 14, 2, 20, 11. Cari kartu 11 dengan membuka loker satu per satu dari kiri. Berapa loker yang dibuka sampai kartu 11 ketemu?
id.q3: Isi kartu di dalam loker, dari kiri: 6, 1, 7. Cari kartu 6 dengan membuka loker satu per satu dari kiri. Berapa loker yang dibuka sampai kartu 6 ketemu?
id.q4: Isi kartu di dalam loker, dari kiri: 4, 9, 4, 2, 9. Cari kartu 9 dengan membuka loker satu per satu dari kiri. Berapa loker yang dibuka sampai kartu 9 ketemu?
id.q5: Isi kartu di dalam loker, dari kiri: 13, 7, 18, 7, 5, 7. Cari kartu 7 dengan membuka loker satu per satu dari kiri. Berapa loker yang dibuka sampai kartu 7 ketemu?
id.q6: Isi kartu di dalam loker, dari kiri: 3, 16, 10, 8. Cari kartu 5 dengan membuka loker satu per satu dari kiri. Berapa loker dibuka sebelum yakin kartu 5 tidak ada?
id.q7: Isi kartu di dalam loker, dari kiri: 21, 9, 14, 30, 2, 18, 6. Cari kartu 12 dengan membuka loker satu per satu dari kiri. Berapa loker dibuka sebelum yakin kartu 12 tidak ada?
id.q8: Isi kartu di dalam loker, dari kiri: 5, 11, 19, 2, 8, 15, 1. Cari kartu 1 dengan membuka loker satu per satu dari kiri. Berapa loker yang dibuka sampai kartu 1 ketemu?
id.q9: Tiket kereta tujuan: Bogor, Depok, Cikini, Bekasi, Serpong. Petugas mencari tiket Bekasi dari depan, satu per satu. Berapa tiket yang dicek?
id.q10: Ada 15 kartu acak dalam satu baris. Angka yang dicari ternyata ada di kartu paling kanan. Berapa kartu dibuka?
id.q11: Isi kartu di dalam loker, dari kiri: 10, 20, 30, 40. Cari kartu 30 dengan membuka loker satu per satu dari kiri. Berapa loker yang dibuka sampai kartu 30 ketemu?
id.q12: Ada 12 kartu dalam satu baris, dan angka yang dicari tidak ada di sana. Berapa kartu dibuka sebelum yakin angkanya tidak ada?
id.q13: Kartu huruf: K, A, R, E, T, A. Cari huruf A satu per satu dari kiri. Berapa kartu dibuka sampai A pertama ketemu?

en.instruksi: At the station, things are found by opening them one by one from the left and stopping when found. If it isn't there, all of them get opened. Count how many are opened.
en.q1: Cards inside the lockers, from the left: 12, 5, 9, 3, 17, 6. Look for card 3 by opening lockers one by one from the left. How many lockers are opened until card 3 is found?
en.q2: Cards inside the lockers, from the left: 8, 14, 2, 20, 11. Look for card 11 by opening lockers one by one from the left. How many lockers are opened until card 11 is found?
en.q3: Cards inside the lockers, from the left: 6, 1, 7. Look for card 6 by opening lockers one by one from the left. How many lockers are opened until card 6 is found?
en.q4: Cards inside the lockers, from the left: 4, 9, 4, 2, 9. Look for card 9 by opening lockers one by one from the left. How many lockers are opened until card 9 is found?
en.q5: Cards inside the lockers, from the left: 13, 7, 18, 7, 5, 7. Look for card 7 by opening lockers one by one from the left. How many lockers are opened until card 7 is found?
en.q6: Cards inside the lockers, from the left: 3, 16, 10, 8. Look for card 5 by opening lockers one by one from the left. How many lockers are opened before you are sure card 5 is not there?
en.q7: Cards inside the lockers, from the left: 21, 9, 14, 30, 2, 18, 6. Look for card 12 by opening lockers one by one from the left. How many lockers are opened before you are sure card 12 is not there?
en.q8: Cards inside the lockers, from the left: 5, 11, 19, 2, 8, 15, 1. Look for card 1 by opening lockers one by one from the left. How many lockers are opened until card 1 is found?
en.q9: Train tickets to: Bogor, Depok, Cikini, Bekasi, Serpong. The officer looks for the Bekasi ticket from the front, one by one. How many tickets are checked?
en.q10: There are 15 shuffled cards in a row. The number you want turns out to be on the rightmost card. How many cards are opened?
en.q11: Cards inside the lockers, from the left: 10, 20, 30, 40. Look for card 30 by opening lockers one by one from the left. How many lockers are opened until card 30 is found?
en.q12: There are 12 cards in a row, and the number you want is not there. How many cards are opened before you are sure it is missing?
en.q13: Letter cards: K, A, R, E, T, A. Look for the letter A one by one from the left. How many cards are opened until the first A is found?
